issues: No integrity concerns: the change only applies log1p to the training target and expm1 to the predictions. It reads no files and uses no test labels.

Recomputed z of about 2.40 (candidate mean 0.57205 vs incumbent 0.5926, diff 0.02055, SE = 0.007*sqrt(1/2+1/1) = 0.00857) is close to the reported 2.383. The small gap is probably due to the exact sd or rounding of the adjusted values.
The incumbent mean rests on a single run, so its noise carries fully into the comparison. Both candidate runs still beat it by at least 0.018.

expm1 preserves rank order and the loss is Spearman-based, so the back-transform can't change the score. log1p assumes targets above -1; clearance values are non-negative and both runs finished, so this holds.
